headline: Over $750 million already invested in Amulsar project in Armenia; future community investments to exceed $100 million – minister
summary: More than $750 million has been invested in the Amulsar project in Armenia. The minister said the first gold bar is expected in September, with full-scale extraction to follow.
why: Amulsar is a large gold mining project, and first production affects Armenia's export earnings and mining investment.

original_headline: В проект «Амулсар» в Армении уже инвестировано свыше $750 млн, будущие вложения в общины превысят $100 млн – министр
